title: tracking.nudge.requested v1
description: Tracking decided, within its budget of one a day, that the person gets one tracking push now (Tracking Service Spec, Ports; D52). Core sends it as a push only, with the neutral copy in notification-copy.md. The kind only: no module, element, rule or value.

kind.description: REMINDER is the daily logging reminder; INVITE says something new is waiting on the Track tab.
